data.name: The Silent Catalyst
data.detailed_description:
What do your dreams tell you?

The Silent Catalyst is a first-person psychological horror experience where every room is a puzzle and every puzzle is a piece of you.

Play into the fragmented psyche of a mind on the edge. Each level unfolds a different psychological state, a phobia, or a scar from the past. Solve surreal, unnerving puzzles to progress, unlocking rooms that whisper memories, twist reality, and pull you deeper into something you're not sure you want to understand.

There are no second chances. Once a room is completed, it's gone just like a dream you can't return to. Tools exist, but they're fleeting. Use what the environment gives you before it slips away. Narration, scattered clues, and distorted environments guide your descent.

This horror doesn't scream, it lingers.

data.short_description: The Silent Catalyst is a psychological horror where every room unlocks something. It's a compilation of puzzles that whisper and spaces that remember. Slow quiet dread, eerie comfort, and a story that watches you as closely as you watch it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5- 4th Gen or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 – 8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is a psychological horror so it is going to have psychologically disturbing content, but no nudity.
Mild references to alcohol may be present, however, no other drugs other than medically prescribed pills are talked about.
